verdict.rationale: Mastra is a TypeScript framework, so it is driven entirely through its documented programmatic API: `createTool`, `createWorkflow`, `suspend()`/`resume()` and stream converters are all documented, and package APIs ship as embedded docs in `dist/docs` that AI agents can read. It can also be deployed as a Mastra server or used to author MCP servers that expose agents and tools, but no HTTP API reference is evidenced and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Missing for 10: a documented HTTP/REST API reference or OpenAPI spec for the deployed Mastra server, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving it via API.
